reason: Confirmation must report common-frequency and mechanical-power error separately. Both are already included in the unchanged primary point error; current component output covers only relative angles and speeds.
apply_gate: All C processes using the active source identity must have exited. Review isolated diff, run targeted synthetic checks, preserve C provenance, then bind and archive a new D source identity before D scientific execution.
allowed_changes: Add separate component output to confirmation event rows
Require the new field when validating reusable evaluation caches
forbidden_changes: Primary point error, risk or paired confidence interval
Training, candidate selection or frozen comparison
Data generation, split semantics or frozen test access
Production source changes while any C source-bound process is live
actual_interval: Also report the genuine interval min(800, len(event.x)-11) without padding.
alignment: For n future steps use pred[1:n+1] against event.x[11:11+n], dt=0.01 s; never include the initial state as a future error.

common_frequency.physical_sse: Sum of squared errors over n actual future time points

mechanical_power.definition: p = Pm - pm_star, all ten machines
mechanical_power.physical_sse: Sum of squared errors over n*10 scalar values

availability: Record unavailable horizons and nonfinite components explicitly; retain every event and do not filter failed cases to recompute a total.
cache_policy: A cache missing components is incomplete and must be rejected, never silently overwritten or recomputed.
budget: Implementation repair and synthetic checks count in the existing reserve. No new scientific branch, seed or adaptation update.
